name: memctl
description: Local Markdown memory for AI agents: full-text search, a link graph and git-backed history.

root.title: Notes folder
root.description: The folder of Markdown notes memctl serves. Make it a git repository (git init) so every change is recorded.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: One line, up to 200 characters, that tells Claude what this notes folder holds, for example "Work documents of the IT team; no personal notes." Leave empty for none.
